answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows. Consider a island as the anchor of the cost. A ridge stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a pulse...
